name: Oobit Crypto Card
summary: The Oobit Crypto Card is a fee-free virtual card that lets you spend directly from your crypto wallet or in-app balance, no conversion hassle required. This hybrid custody model gives you flexibility most crypto cards don't, plus cashback up to 10% in OOB or 5% in USDT. It supports USDT, Bitcoin, Ethereum, and other stablecoins, and works at 150M+ Visa merchants worldwide, backed by Tether.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Full KYC, including proof of address, required
Virtual card only, no physical card

faq.question: Does the Oobit Crypto Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No. There is no monthly fee. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Oobit Crypto Card?
faq.answer: It charges about 3% on non-base-currency spending.

faq.question: What KYC does the Oobit Crypto Card require?
faq.answer: It requires a government ID plus proof of address.
